webhook.title: Webhook API Keys
webhook.subtitle: Manage webhook API keys for form capture, WhatsApp delivery callbacks, and other external integrations.
webhook.emptyHint: Create an API key to automatically capture forms from external websites as leads.
webhook.keyCreatedWarning: Copy the key now — it is only shown once and cannot be retrieved later.

fields.name: Name
fields.domainsHint: Comma separated. Leave empty to allow all domains.

instructions.title: Integration instructions
instructions.step2: Paste it just before the closing </body> tag on your website.
instructions.step3: All forms on that page will be automatically captured as leads.
instructions.optionSelector: Only capture forms matching a CSS selector (e.g. "#contact-form").
instructions.optionSuccess: Redirect to a URL after a successful submission.
instructions.optionIgnore: Add this to a form element to skip it.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp webhook endpoint
whatsapp.subtitle: Use the URL below with the X-Webhook-API-Key header to deliver inbound messages and receipt callbacks from your WhatsApp provider.
whatsapp.headerHint: Authenticate requests with the X-Webhook-API-Key header. The same key can be rotated below.

rotate.created: New webhook key created. Update the provider first, then revoke the previous key.

gtm.title: Google Tag Manager (GTM)
gtm.subtitle: Optional. Set your GTM container ID so the SDK can load GTM and push a dataLayer event after a successful submission. Configure conversion tags and Enhanced Conversions in GTM.

revokeConfirm.title: Revoke API key
revokeConfirm.message: Are you sure you want to revoke this key? Forms using this key will no longer be captured.

googleLeads.title: Google Lead Form Webhooks
googleLeads.subtitle: Connect Google Ads Lead Forms and map campaigns to service types.
googleLeads.emptyHint: Create a config to start receiving Google Lead Form submissions.
googleLeads.keyCreatedWarning: Copy the key now — it is only shown once and cannot be retrieved later.

instructions.title: Integration instructions
instructions.step1: Copy the webhook URL and Google key above.
instructions.step2: Open your Google Ads lead form and paste the webhook URL and key.
instructions.step3: Send a test lead to confirm delivery.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete config
deleteConfirm.message: Are you sure you want to delete this config? Google will stop delivering leads with this key.

deleteMappingConfirm.title: Delete campaign mapping
deleteMappingConfirm.message: Are you sure you want to delete this campaign mapping?

errors.mappingRequired: Campaign ID and service type are required.
